hooks.prompt: If .afk-mod/state.json exists, read it to understand the current workflow stage. If workflow is 'initialized', remind the user to copy feature-list.csv and run /afk:feature-decompose. If workflow is 'ready_to_develop', suggest /afk:start <task-id> to begin development.

Before writing or editing files, verify that the current workflow stage allows this operation. Read .afk-mod/state.json if it exists. If workflow is 'initialized' and no feature-list.csv exists in .afk-mod/, warn the user to run /afk:feature-decompose first. If workflow is 'awaiting_feature_list', suggest copying feature-list.csv to .afk-mod/ first.

After completing a task, update .afk-mod/state.json to reflect the new state. If a task was completed, update the task status in state.json. If an artifact file was created, update the corresponding stage status.
